title: Ambience Discs
description: A mod that adds Minecraft's ambient background music as playable music discs.
body:
This mod adds all the background songs from minecraft including all alpha and beta albuns from C418.

The discs have a chance to be obtained by a skeleton killing a zombie.



Credits & Copyright Disclaimer
